meta.name: Rita
meta.description:
Independent, outspoken and adored by her students, private school teacher Rita fares less well with adults.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 9 Feb 2012 · Denmark · 38 min
Studio: Faroe Film · Network: TV 2

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8 | S3 8/8 | S4 not on server | S5 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: The Idealist
videos.overview: Ricco's father-in-law turns out to be Rita's high school sweetheart. Meanwhile, Rita's battle at school with a 14-year-old know-it-all goes wrong.

videos.title: The Teacher
videos.overview: A new student suffers socially when his parents demand a schoolwide ban on sugar. Meanwhile, Rita's estranged mother wants to get back in touch.

videos.title: The Anarchist
videos.overview: When a school talent show forces Rita to re-evaluate her uncompromising relationship to truth, she realizes she's been doing some lying of her own.

videos.title: The Whore
videos.overview: Rita finds porn on Jeppe's computer and fears he'll share what she knows firsthand is a destructive relationship to sex.

videos.title: The Protector
videos.overview: Rita protects a troubled kid with ADHD from vandalism charges but forgets to fight for her own son when he's the victim of hate crime bullying.

videos.title: The Hypocrite
videos.overview: Rita finds drugs at school, but the accused student points Rita in the direction of her own son, Jeppe. Molly gets a job at a hospice.

videos.title: The Princess
videos.overview: When Rita takes over a second-grade theater production, her own life story begins to blend with the fairy tale the kids are playing out.

videos.title: The Mother
videos.overview: A lonely Rita starts hanging out with Rosa. But all hell breaks loose when Rosa realizes that Rita was the one her dad was having an affair with.

videos.title: The Grown Up
videos.overview: A pregnant Rita faces a difficult decision: She can keep the baby but never reveal who the father is, or she can get an abortion.

videos.title: The Garden
videos.overview: Rita and Rasmus move in together, and Rita tries her best to act like an adult -- until Rasmus puts a rose bed in her beloved wilderness of a garden.

videos.title: And Baby Makes Three
videos.overview: Rita "lends" her own grandchild to a pregnant girl in her class in an attempt to convince her to get an abortion, but the plan backfires.

videos.title: Team Player
videos.overview: It's sports day, and Helle wants to protect the losers from having an upsetting experience -- but Rita takes up the struggle for the right to win.

videos.title: I Love You
videos.overview: Another teacher is terrorizing Rita's student, and Rita has to take up the cause -- but it's not easy when the teacher uses bureaucracy as a weapon.

videos.title: First Love
videos.overview: A student in Rita's class falls hopelessly in love with her at the same time that her own first love, Tom, reappears in her life at a family baptism.

videos.title: The Role Model
videos.overview: Rita and Rasmus struggle to save their relationship, but an innocent meeting with a colleague has unexpected consequences.

videos.title: Weeds
videos.overview: For the first time in her life, Rita has gone down for the count, but she has to rediscover her fighting spirit when Erik strikes a student.

videos.title: The Candidate
videos.overview: Inspired by local politics, Rita holds an election in her class. Uffe gets a job at the school, but it sparks conflict with Hjordis.

videos.title: The Basement
videos.overview: Helle hires a motivational coach for the students. Meanwhile Jeppe moves in with his boyfriend, and Rita struggles with living on her own.

videos.title: The Sponsor Kid
videos.overview: A problem student goes on a destructive rampage, Hjordis makes progress with her second graders, and a man from Rita's past shows up.

videos.title: Evening Classes
videos.overview: To combat loneliness, Rita invites some students to her house. Meanwhile, Hjordis tries to spice up her sex life with Uffe.

videos.title: Lice
videos.overview: Rita's fourth graders come down with head lice, and she decides to delouse them herself. Meanwhile, Helle faces evaluation by her peers.

videos.title: Free Fall
videos.overview: Rita tries to keep the police in the dark when Hjordis decides on the perfect item to bury in a time capsule: marijuana.

videos.title: The Leader
videos.overview: Overcome by stress, Helle asks Rita to become the school's temporary headmaster, and Hjordis's class celebrates Saint Lucy's day with style.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Rita agrees to act as temporary headmaster in Helle's absence, and Hjordis and Uffe face an important decision regarding their relationship.
